steps.title: Accept Loan or Make Offer
steps.description: Either accept a loan offer on your NFT, or make loan offers to other borrowers.

steps.title: Complete Full Loan Cycle
steps.description: Repay loan to reclaim NFT or successfully collect on a loan you funded.
steps.tips: Multiple completed cycles = higher eligibility

steps.description: Move ETH to Arbitrum for lower fees.

steps.title: Connect to NFTperp
steps.description: Visit NFTperp protocol and connect wallet.

steps.title: Open Perpetual Positions
steps.description: Trade long or short on NFT collection floor prices with leverage.

name: Tensor
description: Solana's leading NFT marketplace and trading platform with advanced analytics and AMM pools.

steps.title: Connect Solana Wallet
steps.description: Visit Tensor and connect Phantom, Solflare, or another Solana wallet.

steps.title: Trade Popular Collections
steps.description: Buy/sell NFTs from top Solana collections: Mad Lads, Tensorians, y00ts.

steps.title: Provide AMM Liquidity
steps.description: Deposit SOL into AMM pools to earn trading fees and boost airdrop eligibility.

name: Arcade

requirements: Borrow or lend using NFT collateral

steps.description: Connect wallet to Arcade protocol.

steps.title: Borrow Against NFTs
steps.description: Use your NFTs as collateral to borrow ETH or stablecoins.

steps.title: Lend to Earn Yield
steps.description: Provide capital to the lending pool and earn interest from borrowers.
steps.tips: Diversify across multiple loans

steps.description: Visit Element Market and connect wallet. Verify email for extra points.

steps.title: Cross-Chain Trading
steps.description: Trade NFTs on at least 2 chains: Ethereum, BNB Chain, or Polygon.

steps.title: Use Batch Features
steps.description: Test batch buying, batch listing, and bulk transfers to demonstrate power-user behavior.
steps.tips: Batch operations save significant gas

name: Highlight
description: No-code NFT minting platform for creators with customizable mint pages.

steps.description: Connect wallet to Highlight platform.

steps.title: Mint from Drops
steps.description: Participate in 10+ different mints from various creators on Highlight.

steps.tips: Competitive pricing increases bidding activity

steps.description: Bid on at least 3 collections. Higher bids and longer duration earn more points.

steps.title: Participate in Blast Integration
